courses.overview: 從資料版本、管線相依與訓練重現延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend data versions, pipeline dependencies and training reproduction to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 模型監測與漂移偵測
related.why: 共同連結模型、資料與時間版本
related.whyEn: Both connect model, data and temporal versions
related.transfer: 共同連結模型、資料與時間版本
related.transferEn: Both connect model, data and temporal versions
related.difference: 漂移監測比較執行分佈而非僅重現訓練
related.differenceEn: Drift monitoring compares operation distributions, not merely training reproduction

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「模型監測與漂移偵測」共用的資料／元件介面；以「共同連結模型、資料與時間版本」指出能保留的條件。
針對「漂移監測比較執行分佈而非僅重現訓練」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with model monitoring and drift detection; use "Both connect model, data and temporal versions" to identify retained conditions.
For "Drift monitoring compares operation distributions, not merely training reproduction", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 數位鑑識證據保全
related.why: 共同使用摘要與可追溯紀錄
related.whyEn: Both use digests and traceable records
related.transfer: 共同使用摘要與可追溯紀錄
related.transferEn: Both use digests and traceable records
related.difference: ML 管線還需參數與隨機性，而鑑識重交接
related.differenceEn: ML adds parameters and randomness; forensics emphasizes custody

courses.summary: 機器學習資料版本管理從資料版本、管線相依與訓練重現連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Machine-learning data versioning connects interfaces, data and acceptance through data versions, pipeline dependencies and training reproduction. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「資料身分」到「交付驗收」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect data identity to delivery acceptance, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: 資料版本把研究輸入與可重現管線連結；本課以小型合成資料示範，不將 metadata 當作公開資料授權。
history.textEn: Data versioning connects research inputs with reproducible pipelines; synthetic examples do not treat metadata as data-release permission.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
